errors.what: “Solid (−)” is used in the legend, but the stimulatory arrows from the hypothalamus to the pituitary and from the pituitary to the ovary are also solid.
errors.why_wrong: The same line style represents both forward stimulation and negative feedback, so the legend can mislead students about what the forward arrows mean.

errors.what: “Dotted (−): inhibin B from granulosa cells suppresses FSH only.”
errors.why_wrong: Inhibin B is especially relevant in the follicular phase, but inhibin A also suppresses FSH and is prominent in the luteal phase. Naming only B in a whole-cycle diagram may imply it is the only ovarian inhibin involved.

errors.what: The node labels, feedback labels, and legend are very small within a large image with substantial blank space below the figure.
errors.why_wrong: Several labels are difficult to read at the supplied size, although none appears clipped or overlapping.

verdict: The axis and three feedback relationships are largely correct and support the caption. Clarify the solid-line convention, add the role of inhibin A, and enlarge the diagram text.
